# Simonton Reflections 5500 DH - Window Research Findings

## PRODUCT OVERVIEW
- **Manufacturer**: Simonton Windows (Cornerstone Building Brands/Ply Gem family) 
- **Material Class**: Premium vinyl replacement window
- **Configuration Type**: Double Hung (DH)
- **Country of Origin**: USA
- **Market Position**: Mid-to-upper tier vinyl window line

## CONFIRMED FINDINGS [LOCKED] [LOCKED]

### PERFORMANCE SPECIFICATIONS


Standard 44" W x 63"H double hung with Low-E 366 glass package: U-factor 0.31, SHGC 0.18, VT 0.41, air infiltration 0.14 scfm/ft²
. 

Upgraded glass configuration with Super Spacer and ProSolar: U-factor 0.30, SHGC 0.24, with Energy Star qualification for Northern, North Central, South Central, and Southern regions
. 

User-reported performance with 1" IGU and Super Spacer: U-factor 0.28, SHGC 0.18
.

### FRAME AND CONSTRUCTION


Frame, sill and sash feature 16 total chambers to maximize insulation and interior comfort
. 

Fusion-welded construction creates a one-piece frame and sash for reliable strength and durability
. 

Standard 3/4" insulating glass unit with ProSolar Low-E Glass, Argon gas and Intercept spacer system
.

### WEATHERSTRIPPING AND SEALING

Triple-fin weatherstripping seal virtually eliminates air and water infiltration (from supplemental research file). 
Multiple points of weatherstripping inhibit wind and rain penetration (from supplemental research file).

### SPACER SYSTEMS


Available with multiple spacer options: Intercept spacer system helps keep glass warm and expands and contracts for reduced seal failure; Supercept spacer system utilizes stainless-steel alloy for increased durability and thermal efficiency; non-metallic foam Super Spacer is non-conductive and virtually eliminates temperature transfer
.

### STRUCTURAL CERTIFICATIONS


AAMA Gold Label Certification - windows are manufactured to the industry-leading AAMA Gold Certification Program for product excellence
. 

For AAMA Gold Label certification, windows must be tested to energy-efficient specifications of the National Fenestration Rating Council (NFRC) including U-Factor, Solar Heat Gain Coefficient and Visible Transmittance
.

### DESIGN PRESSURE RATINGS (NEW FINDING)


Simonton 5500 windows have a Design Pressure (DP) rating ranging from 35 to 60. The higher the DP, the better the air tightness or resistance to air infiltration
. 
DP rating for this window is 25. It means that the window can withstand winds of up to 75 mph
 (alternate source confirms DP:25 for certain configurations).

### WARRANTY COVERAGE


Double lifetime limited warranty on mainframe (and all vinyl materials), components, screens and hardware. Double lifetime means if you sell your home, the next buyer gets the warranty for their lifetime as well (homeowners must notify the company in writing of the transfer). Glass is covered for 20 years, although prorated. Warranty covers glass breakage (3 years), laminated glass (20 years), interior laminates (double lifetime), and factory applied coatings (10 years)
. 
Installation coverage and labor to fix warranty issues are NOT covered by the warranty (from supplemental research file).

### ENERGY STAR QUALIFICATION


Select 5500 window styles with optional triple-pane glass are recognized as Most Efficient by ENERGY STAR in 2025. The Most Efficient distinction identifies products offering cutting-edge energy efficiency and represents the best-performing ENERGY STAR windows available
. 

Triple-pane glass configuration won the ENERGY STAR 2020 Most Energy Efficient designation
.

### BALANCE SYSTEM

Uses constant force balance mechanism (from supplemental research file) which 
charges extra for features that many companies offer standard such as balance covers
.

### GOOD HOUSEKEEPING AWARDS (NEW FINDINGS)


The Simonton 5500 Double Hung window has received the Good Housekeeping Seal in recognition of its uncompromising quality, exceptional energy efficiency and robust safety and security features
. 
Simonton 5500 Double Hung Windows have been awarded a Good Housekeeping 2026 Home Reno Award. The Good Housekeeping Institute's Home Improvement & Outdoor Lab awarded the 5500 Collection Double Hung Windows for its efficiency and protection against drafts and moisture
.

## RED FINDINGS [LOCKED] [LOCKED]

### CLASS ACTION LITIGATION (2016)

Class action lawsuit filed October 17, 2016 in U.S. District Court for the District of Minnesota against Simonton Building Products LLC alleging breach of warranty, design defect, failure to warn, fraud, liability, negligence, product liability and unjust enrichment. Complaint alleged insulated glass windows showed defects early on, including internal condensation, corrosion of metallic films and/or improper glass preparation leading to visible fingerprints and smudges (from supplemental research file). 
Reflections, Asure, Prism, Impressions, StormBreaker Plus, ProFinish, DaylightMax, Lumera were among the former or current Simonton lines named in the suit (from supplemental research file).

### INSTALLATION QUALITY CONTROL ISSUES


Customer complaint: "I ordered Simonton Reflections 5500 Windows, supposedly their premium window - the installers put in Simonton 5050, the economy model. Then there were problems with the new windows and neither the contractor nor the Simonton Rep seemed to be the least bit familiar with the product"
. **INSTALL-CONFOUND: LOW** (product mix-up, not installation failure).

### MANUFACTURING QUALITY CONCERNS


Customer reported: "I ordered nine 5500 windows and two of them were delivered with very visible defects that should have been caught at the factory. It took two tries and three tries respectively before the idiots at the factory could get it right as far as sizing the replacements"
. **INSTALL-CONFOUND: LOW** (factory defects).


Workmanship complaint: "The cut extends 1/4 inch beyond the edge of the upper sash and the material visible thru the over cut gives the appearance of shoddy workmanship... When I contacted Simonton their Service Solutions Department Rep said they would send me 4 new lower sashes. They sent me 8 new sashes and every one of the lower sashes had the same over cuts and looked shoddy"
. **INSTALL-CONFOUND: LOW** (manufacturing defect).

### RECENT QUALITY ISSUES (NEW FINDING)


Professional installer assessment: "In my opinion, the 5500 Reflection windows are of a fairly low quality. I just finished a large 18 window job, and I wasn't impressed at all. I encountered numerous sashes with a pretty significant bow in the middle of the sides, resulting in a gap to the frame. My guess would be it's from 'wet setting' the glass into the sash"
 (March 2024). **INSTALL-CONFOUND: LOW** (manufacturing defect).

## YELLOW FINDINGS [LOCKED] [LOCKED]

### DESIGN AGE CONCERNS


Window Dog review notes: "This model is getting a little long in the tooth. It utilizes some older design elements and offers less than outstanding performance numbers. There are many old and outdated design elements in this product that just aren't necessary anymore"
. 

Adams Exteriors noted: "The Simonton Reflections 5500 Series Window has been on the market for a very long time. We sold a ton of these windows in the 90's and into the 2000's but for the most part, the window has aged without upgrades"
.

### THICK FRAME CONCERNS


Window Dog criticism: "The biggest drawback for me is the thickness of the vinyl. You certainly get less glass area with the Simonton Reflections 5500 than you would with some competing products"
. 

Some Simonton windows like the 5500 series use thicker frames than many other models, meaning "the same size window will provide less glass area than you'd get with a different window model"
.

### BALANCE SYSTEM LIMITATIONS


Sash stops required: "This block at the top of the frame prevents the sash from opening all the way... On smaller windows you won't be able to open the window as far as you'd expect... They have to because of the cheap constant force balance mechanism used in the jambs"
.
